issue.title: calculator.add() returns wrong result for positive numbers
issue.body: The add() function in calculator.py returns a - b instead of a + b. For example, add(2, 3) returns -1 instead of 5. This is a simple one-line fix.

buggy_line: return a - b  # BUG: should be a + b
expected_patch:
--- a/calculator.py
+++ b/calculator.py
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 
def add(a, b):
     """Add two numbers."""
-    return a - b  # BUG: should be a + b
+    return a + b
